run_eval_beir: run the Contriever model evaluation on a BEIR benchmark dataset using argparse CLI
run_load_retriever: run the load_retriever function to load a Contriever model and tokenizer from a path
run_evaluate_model: run the evaluate_model function to evaluate a retriever on a BEIR dataset with metrics
review_main: review the main evaluation function that loads a model and runs BEIR benchmark evaluation
review_argparse_cli: review the argparse CLI arguments for dataset, model path, batch size, and scoring options
